calls.basis: the prospectively declared AD-15/AD-16 arm under test
calls.resolutionRule: Right if the AD-15 composite gate PASSES for this arm; Wrong if it FAILS; Unresolved until the gate evaluates. (Interim reviews may re-call on descriptive evidence; doing so journals THIS call as superseded, outcome Unresolved.)

calls.basis: oos ρ −0.05, CI spans zero at call time (remains the storage primary / legacy reference series)
calls.resolutionRule: Wrong if, at the gate-resolution instant, default's out-of-sample ρ interval excludes zero POSITIVELY on the then-current leaderboard; Right otherwise.

calls.basis: oos rho negative with the 95% interval excluding zero on the 2026-08-29 excess-vs-universe-v1 leaderboard (filings-led-v2 -0.159 [-0.223,-0.093]; halfnoted -0.149 [-0.214,-0.084]; nonoted -0.139 [-0.204,-0.074]; 872 obs, 74 companies, 12 dates); the notedness ablation pair moves nothing, so the filings-channel hypothesis, not the discount, is what fails. Descriptive, pooled, pre-freeze retrospective.
calls.resolutionRule: Wrong (re-call Trial) if a later leaderboard with at least 24 out-of-sample dates shows this arm's oos rho interval upper bound above zero; Right if it stays at or below zero at that point. Scoring continues; only prominence stops.
